schema.decision_record.stage_ref.label: Which stage is this for?
schema.decision_record.stage_ref.help: Pick one stage of the plan. It is named by its short name.
schema.decision_record.chosen_option_ids: The id of one option of this stage.
The ids of the chosen stage options. Leave empty if you give steps instead.
schema.decision_record.decision_method.h: It must match the stage's decision method.
schema.decision_record.decider_role.help: A role, never a named person.
schema.decision_record.authority.label: What gives that role the authority to decide?
schema.decision_record.rationale.label: Why was this chosen?
schema.decision_record.rationale.help: Say what weighed most, without naming people.
schema.decision_record.dissent_notes.hel: Short notes on views that differed. Optional.
schema.decision_record.legal_gate_record: The rule or limit the choice was checked against.
A web address or a rule id with its version.
The constitution, the local pack, or both.
Record the check that was made before choosing. This is not legal advice.
schema.decision_record.steps.step.label: What is the step?
A role, never a named person.
schema.decision_record.steps.done_criter: How will anyone know it is done?
A check someone else could make.
schema.decision_record.steps.label: Steps that follow
schema.decision_record.steps.help: Each step has an owner role and a way to tell it is done.
The id of the stage choice. The server sets it.
schema.decision_record.assumptions.label: What does this choice assume?
schema.decision_record.assumptions.help: Short plain statements, one to eight.
schema.decision_record.review_date.label: When will it be reviewed?
